mainEntity.name: How do I choose between different fence repair companies for stability restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a fence repair company, consider their experience with different types of fencing materials and their track record for quality workmanship. Look for local contractors familiar with specific soil and weather conditions in areas like Berkeley and Oakland, as these can impact fence longevity. Request detailed proposals that outline the scope of work, materials used, and warranty information to make a practical comparison.
